phase-locking.obstruction: no oscillation: at 11 values of beta in [0.5, 2.5] every start settles on a stable state or does not become periodic
phase-locking.obstruction_short: no oscillation in the control range

write_points.kind: supercritical pitchfork: symmetric write; a small bias chooses the state

law.start_of_sweep: the unwritten branch followed back from the write point
law.obstruction_in_nonlinear_stage: the law differs from the full dynamics by up to 0.033 (11.7 errors): the choice is not complete at the end of the linear stage (noise during the nonlinear stage, or a further mode brought into play), and the written states retain it (1 % change state during a hold of 56.6 time units)

write_points.kind: subcritical pitchfork: symmetric, but the state jumps to a distant branch

law.start_of_sweep: the unwritten branch followed back from the write point
law.obstruction_in_nonlinear_stage: the law agrees with the full dynamics, but the written states at the end of the sweep do not retain the choice: 10 % of the trajectories change state during a hold of 56.6 time units at the end value of the control. The full dynamics gives the steady-state selection under the bias, an equilibrium write, not the linear-stage law; a retained write needs deeper states at the end of the sweep (a longer sweep, or less noise)
